newsitem.title: GERMANY: Five injured in explosion in Berlin.
newsitem.headline: Five injured in explosion in Berlin.

text.p: Five people were injured on Sunday, one of them seriously, in an explosion in the centre of Berlin, a police spokesman said.
He said it was not yet known what had caused the blast. The blast occurred in a yard attached to apartment buildings and those injured were children and youths, he said.
Bombs left over from World War Two are still occasionally found in Germany, but police did not know if one had caused the explosion and had no more immediate details about the blast.
